subject: Payment failed and now we're locked to view-only
body: Our company card was replaced last week and I forgot to update it. This morning Pharos says payment failed and nobody can edit tasks. We have a launch review at 2pm. How do I fix this?

subject: Refund for the wrong plan
body: I picked the Business plan by mistake when upgrading and was charged $240. I only needed Team. Please refund the difference, I noticed it the same day.

subject: Can I set tasks to repeat on the last Friday of the month?
body: We run a monthly wrap-up on the last Friday of each month. Is there a way to make a recurring task follow that pattern? I only see daily, weekly and monthly by date. If it's not possible, I'd love to see it added.

subject: Closing our workspace
body: We're winding down the agency at the end of the month. Please tell me how to cancel the subscription and whether we'll be charged again.

subject: GitHub links stopped appearing on tasks
body: We connected GitHub months ago and pull requests used to attach to tasks automatically. Since Monday nothing attaches. Disconnecting and reconnecting made no difference.

subject: Way too many emails
body: I get an email for every single comment on every task I've ever touched. How do I turn this down to just things assigned to me?

subject: Using a template for every new client
body: Every new client gets the same 12 columns and the same starter tasks. What's the best way to set up a project so I can copy it each time instead of rebuilding it?

subject: Attachments upload then disappear
body: I attach a PDF to a task, it shows a progress bar and says done, but when I reopen the task the file isn't there. It happens with every PDF over about 5 MB. Smaller files are fine.

subject: Login code never arrives
body: I use text-message verification and haven't received a code in two days. I changed my phone number last month and never updated it in Pharos. I can't get in and have a filing due Friday.

subject: Adding two freelancers
body: I want to bring in two freelancers for a month who should only see one project. Do they need full seats, and can they be limited to that project?

subject: Please delete my client's data
body: One of our clients has asked that everything we hold about them be erased, including the project notes in Pharos. What do I need to do on my side, and what does Pharos do on its side?

subject: Is anyone else seeing errors right now?
body: Every page in Pharos has been giving us a 'something went wrong' screen for 20 minutes. Three of us on different networks all see it. Is there an incident?

subject: Possible leaked API token
body: I accidentally pasted a Pharos API token into a public GitHub issue about an hour ago. I deleted it, but it was visible for a while. Should I be worried, and what should I do?

subject: Before we buy
body: We're on day 6 of the trial with 8 people. Is the Team plan priced per person, and does it include the timeline view and Slack? Do you offer an annual discount?

subject: Love the new timeline
body: No question, just a note for the team. The timeline view made our Monday planning meeting ten minutes shorter. Thank you for building it.

subject: Guest post opportunity
body: We can place your brand on 50 high-authority blogs for a one-time fee. Reply with your budget and we'll send a package list.

subject: Does Pharos have a mobile app with offline mode?
body: I travel a lot and often have no signal. Can I use Pharos offline on my phone and have it sync when I'm back online? If not, please consider this a request.

subject: Why did I get an email about a login from Romania?
body: I got a message saying someone signed in to my Pharos account from Romania this morning. I've never been there and it wasn't me. I haven't changed my password yet.
